description: This PHP source file appears to be a class test script related to the TestLink open source test management platform. It contains code to initialize the environment, instantiate test project objects, and invoke various methods for testing purposes, such as creating projects, copying projects, retrieving test suites, keywords, requirements, and linked custom fields.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class representing test projects, providing methods for creating, copying, and retrieving project elements such as test suites, keywords, and requirements.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test project with specified parameters such as name, color, options, and notes.

methods.name: get_accessible_for_user
methods.description: Retrieves test projects accessible to a specific user.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Fetches keywords associated with a project.

methods.name: get_first_level_test_suites
methods.description: Retrieves first-level test suites for a project.

methods.name: get_keywords_tcases
methods.description: Retrieves test cases associated with keywords.

methods.name: get_linked_custom_fields
methods.description: Gets custom fields linked to the project.

methods.name: getReqSpec
methods.description: Retrieves requirement specifications for the project.

methods.name: get_srs_by_title
methods.description: Fetches SRS (Software Requirements Specification) by title.

methods.name: check_srs_title
methods.description: Checks if an SRS title exists in a project.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a project or SRS by ID.

methods.name: get_all_testcases_id
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of all test cases in a project.

methods.name: check_tplan_name_existence
methods.description: Checks for existing test plan names within a project.

methods.name: get_all_testplans
methods.description: Retrieves all test plans for a project.
